title_zh: 看清足迹但不跟进草丛

scenario.goal_zh: 询问泥地足迹及动物活动，并选择留在小径上观察而不追踪动物

context_zh: 自然步道上，游客杰德向向导询问路边的动物足迹。
author: author-phase05-c

sentences.speaker: Jade
sentences.text: There are little prints in the mud beside the path. Could they be from a fox?

sentences.speaker: Ranger Theo
sentences.text: Possibly, but the edges are blurred. I would not identify the animal from these alone.

sentences.speaker: Jade
sentences.text: Do foxes hunt in this field?

sentences.speaker: Ranger Theo
sentences.text: Sometimes. We have seen them searching for small animals here in the evening.

sentences.speaker: Jade
sentences.text: Shall we follow the prints into the grass?

sentences.speaker: Ranger Theo
sentences.text: Let us stay on the path. We can look through the binoculars without disturbing whatever is there.

sentences.speaker: Jade
sentences.text: Good idea. I will take a photograph of the prints from here first.
